help.title: Help
help.intro: Questions about a booking or a machine? Talk to a person.
help.q1: How do I book a machine?
help.a1: Pick the job, your village and your dates, then choose a machine and send the request. The owner has 2 hours to say yes. Your booking code, like KR-1234, appears in My bookings.
help.a2: In the last step of booking you choose UPI, card, net banking or pay after the work. The deposit is shown separately and is not part of what you pay.
help.a3: Open the booking in My bookings and tap Cancel. It is free until 24 hours before the start time.
help.q4: What if the machine breaks down?
help.a4: Call the owner from the booking page, then tap Report a problem so we know. We read every report.
help.q5: How do I list my machine?
help.a5: Go to Settings, turn on I list machines, then add your machine with its price, place and photos. Upload a photo of the RC (registration certificate) too; we check it.
help.a6: This is a demo; no real money moves.
help.reportBody: Something wrong with a booking? Open it from My bookings and tap Report a problem.
help.placeholder: Support numbers are not set yet.

price.title: How we price
price.lead: You see the full price before you ask for a machine. There are no extras at the end.
price.formula: Your price = the owner's rate + diesel (if it is not included). The deposit comes back after the job.
price.exIntro: A {hp} HP tractor at {rate} for {hours} hours, diesel included:
price.deposit1: For a job under 8 hours the deposit is 25% of the rent, but never more than a fixed amount for that kind of machine.
price.deposit2: For a longer job it is 15% of the rent, or the fixed amount, whichever is higher.
price.deposit3: The fixed amounts start at ₹500 for a sprayer and ₹1,950 for a small tractor, and go up to ₹12,500 for a combine harvester. All amounts are whole rupees.
price.fee: We take 13.5% of the rent. It comes out of the owner's share and is never added to your bill.
price.feeEx: On {rent} of rent the owner keeps {keep}.
price.rates: Each owner sets one rate per hour, per acre or per day. We show owners what similar machines nearby charge, and they decide.
price.cancel: Cancel for free until 24 hours before the start. After that, cancelling may cost the deposit.
price.sourcesIntro: The numbers on our welcome page come from these.
price.src1: Agriculture Census 2015–16 (Government of India): 86.21% of farm holdings are small or marginal, under 2 hectares.
price.src2: Agriculture Census 2015–16: the average operational holding is 1.08 hectares.
price.src3: Reports in 2025 put India's farm mechanisation at about 47%, against about 95% in the United States.
price.srcNote: If newer census figures are published, we update the page.

s1.p: [LEGAL REVIEW NEEDED] KhetiRental helps farmers find farm machines and helps owners rent them out. By using it you agree to these terms.

s2.p: [LEGAL REVIEW NEEDED] A booking is a request to the owner. It is confirmed only when the owner accepts. Cancelling is free until 24 hours before the start.

s3.p: [LEGAL REVIEW NEEDED] Payments in this version are simulated. No real money moves.

s4.p: [LEGAL REVIEW NEEDED] Owners must be the lawful owner of the machine, keep their details true, and keep the machine safe to use.

s5.p: [LEGAL REVIEW NEEDED] Terms about damage, accidents and disputes between renters and owners are to be written.

s6.p: [LEGAL REVIEW NEEDED] We may update these terms. The date of the latest version will be shown here.

s1.p: Your name, mobile number or email, and the places and dates you search or book. Owners also upload photos of their machine and its RC.

s2.p: Your mobile number, email and location are used only for bookings: to find machines near you, to show the owner who is asking, and to send you updates.

s3.p: The exact location of a farm or a machine is shared only after a booking is confirmed.

s4.p: We do not collect Aadhaar. Payments are simulated, so we hold no card or bank details.

s5.p: In Settings you can delete your account. We remove your name, mobile number, email and sign-in. Past bookings stay for the other person, without your details.

s6.p: [LEGAL REVIEW NEEDED] The full privacy policy, including retention periods, the data controller and a grievance contact, is to be written.
